discription: A simple plucked string sound generated by exciting a delay line with a short noise impulse and controlled by an ADSR amplitude envelope. It uses Pluck.ar for the string model.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, decay=0.8;var sig, excitationEnv, ampEnv;ampEnv = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.005, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2);excitationEnv = EnvGen.ar(Env.perc(0.001, 0.05), gate: gate, doneAction: 0);var excitation = WhiteNoise.ar * excitationEnv * 0.5;sig = Pluck.ar(in: excitation, trig: 1, maxdelaytime: 1.0 / 100, delaytime: 1.0 / freq, decay: decay, freq: freq, bpfreq: freq, rq: 0.5);sig = sig * amp * ampEnv;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
